title: Seed Delight Renewed
description: A maintained fork of the Seed Delight mod. It has bug fixes and updates!
body:
# Seed Delight Renewed **A maintained Fabric port of Seed Delight - forest foraging fully integrated with Farmer's Delight.** Seed Delight Renewed is a fork of the original [Seed Delight](https://github.com/HiedaCamellia/SeedDelight) by HiedaCamellia, ported to Fabric 1.20.1 and rebuilt to work natively with [Farmer's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated). All content has been reviewed, rebalanced, and extended with new dishes, proper food tiers, and full FD tag compatibility. --- ## What does it add? Seed Delight expands Farmer's Delight with ingredients and dishes sourced from forest biomes. Every ingredient has a processing chain that ends in cooking-pot meals, baked goods, or drinks.
Click to expand: full ingredient & dish list ### Acorn > Acorn → Acorn Kernel → Acorn Tofu → Raw Acorn Noodle → Pasta dishes - **Acorn Kernel** - cut acorns on a cutting board - **Acorn Tofu** - cooked from acorn kernels - **Stir Fried Cabbage with Acorn** - vegetable bowl, Nourishment 1:00 - **Acorn Bread** - baked good - **Raw Acorn Noodle** - cut from acorn tofu; edible but may cause Hunger (30% chance), just like FD's raw pasta - **Acorn Pasta with Meatballs** - hearty bowl, Nourishment 3:00 - **Acorn Pasta with Mutton Chop** - hearty bowl, Nourishment 3:00 ### Pine Nut > Pinecone → Pine Nut Kernel → Dishes - **Pine Nut Kernel** - cut pinecones on a cutting board - **Pinenut Gruel** - cooked meal - **Pinenut with Meatballs** - hearty bowl, Nourishment 3:00 - **Pinenut Cake** - baked good - **Pine Needle Wine** - drink, grants Resistance 1:30 ### Sunflower Seed > Sunflower Seed → Fried / Dried variants → Dishes - **Fried Sunflower Seed** - light snack - **Dried Watermelon Seed** / **Dried Pumpkin Seed** - light snacks - **Sunflower Seed Crisp** - baked snack - **Sunflower Seed Toast** - baked good ### Rosehip > Rosehip → Jam Jar → Dishes & Drinks - **Rosehip Jam Jar** - crafting ingredient - **Rosehip Jam Sandwich** - quick snack - **Rosehip Tea** - drink, grants Regeneration 0:10 - **Seed Rosehip Pie** - baked good - **Rosehip Cake** - baked good - **Rosehip Pie** - placeable feast block - **Rose Cookie** - baked treat ### Cherry > Cherry → Jam Jar / Wine → Dishes - **Cherry** - raw fruit; foxes love it - **Cherry Jam Jar** - crafting ingredient - **Cherry Jam Sandwich** - quick snack - **Cherry Pork** - meat bowl, Nourishment 3:00 - **Cherry Ice Cream** - dessert, grants Haste 1:00 + Slowness 0:30 - **Cherry Wine** - drink, grants Haste 1:30 - **Milk Cherry Mousse** - light dessert, grants Regeneration 0:30
--- ## Changes from the original mod This is not just a port - several things were fixed and improved: - **Two new acorn pasta dishes** added (Acorn Pasta with Meatballs, Acorn Pasta with Mutton Chop) - **All hearty bowl meals now grant Nourishment**, scaled by dish weight - matching FD's own food tier logic - **Tooltips use FD's native ConsumableItem system** - no duplicate or incorrectly formatted effect lines - **Full tag compatibility**: meals tagged under `farmersdelight:meals`, drinks under `farmersdelight:drinks`, cherry and rosehip under `c:foods/berries`, breads under `c:foods/breads` - **Raw Acorn Noodle** now matches FD's raw pasta behaviour (edible but risky) - **All four storage blocks** (Acorn Bag, Pinecone Bag, Cherry Crate, Rosehip Crate) correctly axe-mineable --- ## Supported Versions | Minecraft | Status | |-----------|--------| | 1.20.1 | ✅ Active | --- ## Dependencies | Mod | Required | |-----|----------| | [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) | ✅ Required | | [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) | ✅ Required | | [Farmer's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated) | ✅ Required | --- ## Credits - **HiedaCamellia / PartheliaSieboldii** - original Seed Delight mod - **EmpireWarrior** - Fabric port and Seed Delight Renewed maintainer
